narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The area is twelve, so the height is twelve divided by eight.
<bookmark mark='half'/>That forgets the half that sits in front of base times height.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Dividing by eight would give a triangle with double the area.

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>To check, find half of eight times three and half of six times four.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Both should give twelve, because it is the same triangle.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says the height is twelve divided by eight. He forgot the half; half of eight is four, so twelve is divided by four.
